title: HB0745 (110th General Assembly): As introduced, allows security guards who are employed on a part-time basis by a public institution of higher education and who are handgun carry permit holders to carry a handgun on campus in certain circumstances. - Amends TCA Title 39 and Title 49.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2017-02-08; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514071854 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/110/Bill/HB0745.pdf (LegiScan doc 1502361))
provenance.note: Draft dated 2017-02-08, as introduced; replaces the definition of 'employee' in 39-17-1309(e)(11)(E)(i). No passage vote on record.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1309(e)(11)(E)(i)): (i) "Employee" includes: (a) All faculty, staff, and other persons who are employed on a full-time basis by a public institution of higher education; and (b) Security guards who are employed on a part-time basis by a public institution of higher education;
